Print layout
The view selection immediately updates both the preview and print. In ramp view the vehicle is shown vertically: the front or tractor is at the top and the rear opening or ramp is at the bottom. Pallets and the arrangement are rotated, while codes, identifiers, and dimensions remain horizontal relative to the screen and paper for readability. “Black & white” changes both the preview and print and uses patterns and graphic differences instead of colours, for output suitable for monochrome printers.
20' Dry · Requested load: 10 pallets · Found capacity: 11 pallets · 1 free slot
Note: this tool performs an indicative geometry check and does not replace operational verification with the freight forwarder or checks relating to packaging, load securing, safety, pallet bulging, actual vehicle tolerances, and operating constraints. This version calculates floor-level arrangements for rear loading. Weight, load balance, and side loading are not yet included.
